hook: Sell or lose a Fruit unit and it sprouts back bigger: plan your funerals in shop and fight.
loop: Sell or lose Fruit units; each leaves a Sprout in its slot.
Each one laid to rest makes later Sprouts bigger and feeds buffs.
Late, capstones chain refills so dying slots come back huge.

growth.line: Shop sales give lasting buffs each turn; fight Sprouts grow with each death but vanish after.

stars.why: Sprouts inherit half the stats; links the shop and fight builds.
Chains slot refills with growing Sprouts, six times a fight.
Buffs friends while burning himself out; Health becomes fuel.

card_short.u01: Fruit: leaves a Sprout when laid to rest.
card_short.u02: Grows from each funeral; more when the unit beside fell.
card_short.u04: Fruit, and gives another unit Fruit for good.
card_short.u05: Once a turn, gain 1 gold from a shop funeral.
card_short.u06: Start of Combat: kills its left neighbour, takes its Attack.
card_short.u07: Gives Fruit to non-Sprout units beside it.
card_short.u08: Each funeral buffs a random friend; it loses Health.
card_short.u09: Start of Combat: grows with the Register.
card_short.u10: Can't be sold; grows from last turn's funerals.
card_short.u12: Fruit; Sprouts also get half the dead unit's stats.
card_short.u13: Shop units grow per shop funeral; bought ones keep it.
card_short.u14: Shop funerals permanently buff all your other Guild units.
card_short.u15: Fruit; on death buffs your board by the fight's count.
card_short.u16: Enemies that kill your units take growing damage.
card_short.u17: Your Sprouts grow with the Register.
card_short.u18: In fights, Sprouts have Fruit, up to six times.
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: copies of your last two fallen fight again.
card_short.x01: Fills the slot; size is the funeral count so far.
card_short.x02: Counts every unit laid to rest this game.

builds.name: The Procession
builds.line: Fruit units in front; each enemy kill refills a bigger slot.

builds.name: The Wake
builds.line: Sell on purpose: buy Fruit, sell it, sell its Sprout.

builds.name: The Undertaker's Bargain
builds.line: Hand other tribes Fruit; Oozes, Birds and Bog tanks feed funerals.

liked: Folding sale and death into one event plays unlike today's tribes.
Funeral order is a real puzzle; slots visibly refill bigger.
worries: Watch: Cordwainer combos with Candlesnuff, Pallbearer, Bellows; also Amanita, Bootlace, Old Fingers.
Unclear: whose sell triggers fire in fights; Pallbearer, Inkcap, Old Fingers wording.
changed: Old Fingers' copies now have Fruit, set stats, and last one fight.
Sprout size fixed when summoned; Sprouts now carry hero damage.
Stinkhorn's free sell loop closed; Lamplighter now grows off the Register.
verdict: Rated 7.0 fun and 6.7 distinct, second of its seed's three; for players who like planning shop-and-fight funerals.
